verdict.rationale: Neon ships an official CLI that a runtime probe confirmed runs from npm. It can provision a project and write `DATABASE_URL` to `.env` (`neon claim create`, `neon init`), and it can inspect a database with `neon inspect db`, which runs 15 read-only checks. However, no evidence shows a command that opens an interactive SQL shell, and project creation is only shown through the temporary claim flow and init linking. Missing for 10: a documented shell-into-database (psql) command, an explicit persistent project/branch create command, and independent hands-on corroboration of the full daily loop.
